verdict.rationale: Square AI (Beta) is a documented in-product assistant that surfaces AI-generated insights and suggestions directly from a seller's own sales/inventory data ('pull game-changing insights from your data', 'just ask about your data'), with concrete seller testimonials describing analyzing best-sellers and plotting sales trends over time. This directly matches the story of getting AI-generated insights from one's own data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of Square AI's output quality beyond vendor testimonials, and more detail on the breadth of insight types supported.
